za-r3-x.title: ZA-R3 / ZA-R3X
za-r3-x.desc: A SCARA precision-transfer platform for high-speed pick-and-place and compact workstations, where ZA-R3 and ZA-R3X are mainly selected by reach.

features.title: Two reach options
features.desc: ZA-R3 offers 450mm reach and ZA-R3X offers 592mm horizontal reach, making it easier to match station coverage.

features.title: Built for fast pick-and-place
features.desc: Maximum horizontal and vertical speeds of 1500mm/s and 500mm/s fit higher-frequency transfer cycles.

features.title: ±0.05mm repeatability
features.desc: Suitable for stations that require consistent pick-and-place and stable positioning.

features.title: Integration-ready interfaces
features.desc: Supports EtherCAT, Gigabit Ethernet, USB and 10 in / 10 out digital I/O for system integration.

params.value: 400mm Z axis: 24kg / 26kg; 750mm Z axis: 31.5kg / 33.5kg; 1160mm Z axis: 39.5kg / 41.5kg

za-r3l-m-h.title: ZA-R3L / ZA-R3M / ZA-R3H
za-r3l-m-h.desc: A SCARA lift variant that adds Z-axis travel, with ZA-R3L, ZA-R3M, and ZA-R3H mainly selected by column height and vertical travel needs.

features.title: L / M / H options
features.desc: The family is grouped by column height and Z-axis travel so different station heights can be matched more quickly.

features.title: Fits pick-and-place with height differences
features.desc: Suitable for loading and unloading tasks that need extra vertical compensation.

features.title: Keeps the compact SCARA form
features.desc: Keeps the compact character of a SCARA platform while extending vertical operating ability.

params.value: Choose by station height and vertical loading travel first

za-r3d6.title: ZA-R3D6
za-r3d6.desc: A 6-axis robotic arm for complex postures and path control, suitable for teaching, validation, and light-duty tasks.

features.title: Flexible 6-axis posture control
features.desc: Suitable for tasks that need more orientation freedom and more complex path planning.

features.title: 540.5mm working radius
features.desc: Provides practical workspace coverage in a relatively compact robot body.

features.title: ±0.03mm repeatability
features.desc: Fits validation and operation scenarios that need consistent motion and stable positioning.

features.title: Flexible mounting
features.desc: Supports any-angle installation and IP54 protection for different equipment layouts.

za-r3t.title: ZA-R3T
za-r3t.desc: An integrated dual-arm platform with a lift axis for grasping, transfer, and bimanual validation tasks from desktop to workstation height.

features.title: Dual 7-DOF arm configuration
features.desc: Each arm has 7 DOF, supporting grasping, transfer, and bimanual validation tasks.

features.title: Balanced reach and precision
features.desc: A 640mm arm span and ±0.1mm repeatability fit common tabletop and workstation-scale operations.

features.title: Selectable lift-axis travel
features.desc: Lift travel options of 400 / 750 / 1160mm help match different bench and station heights.

features.title: Integration-ready interfaces
features.desc: EtherCAT, Gigabit Ethernet, USB and digital I/O make system integration and development easier.

za-m75.title: ZA-M75
za-m75.desc: An autonomous mobile base for light-duty transfer and top-module deployment, with 75kg rated payload, 360° zero-turn steering, and basic indoor navigation.

features.title: 75kg rated payload
features.desc: Suitable for light-duty material transfer and for carrying upper mechanisms or equipment.

features.title: 360° zero-turn steering
features.desc: Suitable for narrower aisles and routes that require frequent turning.

features.title: Indoor navigation and obstacle avoidance
features.desc: Supports map building, positioning, and LiDAR-based obstacle avoidance for common indoor routes.

features.title: 10h runtime with optional auto charging
features.desc: Runtime is about 10 hours, with manual charging and optional charging-dock support.

params.value: 48V@20AH ternary lithium battery; max output 800W; rated charging voltage/current 54.6V@5A
Manual charger; automatic charging dock optional

za-m135.title: ZA-M135
za-m135.desc: An autonomous mobile base for cross-station delivery and mid-load transfer, with 135kg rated payload, 360° zero-turn steering, and basic indoor navigation.

features.title: 135kg rated payload
features.desc: Suitable for higher-load cross-station delivery and material transfer tasks.

features.title: Compact deployment footprint
features.desc: Dimensions of 674×456×327mm help it fit station-side deployment in tighter spaces.

features.title: 360° zero-turn steering
features.desc: Includes basic mapping, positioning, and obstacle avoidance for aisle switching and station-to-station movement.

features.title: 10h runtime with optional auto charging
features.desc: Runtime is about 10 hours, with manual charging and optional automatic charging support.

params.value: 48V@30AH ternary lithium battery; max output 1200W; rated charging voltage/current 54.6V@10A
Manual charger; automatic charging dock optional

za-mr3m.title: ZA-MR3M
za-mr3m.desc: A composite lift robot that combines a mobile base, lift axis, and four-axis robotic arm, suitable for cross-area and multi-height handling and planar-operation tasks.

features.title: Mobile base expands operating range
features.desc: With autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance, it can move across workshop or laboratory spaces.

features.title: 750mm lift for height differences
features.desc: Suitable for pick-and-place and handling between different bench, shelf, or station heights.

features.title: Four-axis configuration for handling and planar tasks
features.desc: Balances mobility, lifting, and end-effector operation while keeping system complexity relatively manageable.

params.value: Laser scanning avoidance, vision avoidance, emergency stop

za-mr3t.title: ZA-MR3T
za-mr3t.desc: An embodied operation platform integrating a mobile base, lift axis, dual arms, and vision cameras, suitable for cross-area, multi-station grasping, transfer, and assembly validation.

features.title: Integrated mobility and manipulation
features.desc: The mobile base, lift axis, dual arms, and vision cameras are integrated into one platform for cross-area deployment and operation validation.

features.title: Fits multi-posture dual-arm tasks
features.desc: The dual-arm structure suits grasping, transfer, and assembly tasks that require posture changes and coordinated operation.

features.title: Vision and navigation ready
features.desc: Combines vision cameras, LiDAR SLAM navigation, and safety-avoidance hardware for mobile-operation and algorithm validation workflows.

params.value: Laser scanning avoidance, vision avoidance, emergency stop

za-rmvr.title: ZA-RMVR
za-rmvr.desc: A teleoperation development platform that integrates a lift axis, dual robotic arms, dexterous hands, a controller, and VR devices for teaching, research, and embodied data collection.

features.title: Intuitive VR teleoperation
features.desc: Based on VR vision and pose capture, it supports teleoperation teaching and coordinated-control validation for both arms.

features.title: Supports multimodal data capture
features.desc: Can record visual, pose, torque, and other data for algorithm training and research.

features.title: Lift axis expands working height
features.desc: The lift axis helps cover work positions from desktops to multi-layer shelving.

params.value: Embodied Dual-Arm VR Teleoperation Development Platform
1× Gigabit Ethernet, 1× USB3.0; 10 digital inputs, 10 digital outputs (PNP)
1× ZA-MR3T embodied dual-arm robot, 2× RH56DFTP dexterous hands, 1× Meta Quest VR headset, 2× controllers

za-rmps.title: ZA-RMPS
za-rmps.desc: A teleoperation development platform for dual-arm master-slave control, contact-task validation, and embodied data collection.

features.title: Contact-torque feedback
features.desc: The master-slave architecture can transmit contact torque in real time so operators can sense changes in resistance and stiffness.

features.title: One-to-one master-slave mapping
features.desc: Matching master and slave arm structures support joint-level mapping with low drift.

features.title: Suitable for extended operation
features.desc: The physical master arm provides support and gravity compensation for longer data-collection and operation sessions.

params.value: Embodied Dual-Arm Master-Slave Teleoperation Development Platform
1× Gigabit Ethernet, 1× USB3.0; 10 digital inputs, 10 digital outputs (PNP)
2× zero-drift robot arms, 2× RH56DFTP dexterous hands, 2× Eyou robot arms, 1× platform

za-rdp.title: ZA-RDP
za-rdp.desc: A drawing and trajectory-teaching platform built on a 6-axis robotic arm, suitable for teaching demos, algorithm validation, and motion-planning experiments.

features.title: For teaching and research demos
features.desc: Suitable for trajectory teaching, drawing demos, algorithm validation and motion-planning experiments.

features.title: Built on a 6-axis robotic arm
features.desc: Uses a 6-DOF robotic arm to balance motion flexibility with path control.

features.title: Clear platform setup
features.desc: The arm, pen module, drawing board, and optical platform make experiment setup and demo reproduction easier.

params.value: 1× ZA-R3D6 6-axis robotic arm, 1× pen module, 1× drawing board, 1× optical platform

za-zg100.title: ZA-ZG100
za-zg100.desc: An integrated control unit based on RK3588 for robot motion control, AI vision processing, and interface integration.

features.title: RK3588 integrated compute and control
features.desc: Built on an 8-core 64-bit RK3588 processor with an onboard NPU for AI vision workloads and motion control in one controller.

features.title: EtherCAT with 1ms cycle
features.desc: Uses EtherCAT and a 1ms control cycle to support synchronized multi-axis servo control.

features.title: 5μs-level control jitter
features.desc: Control jitter can be compressed to 5 microseconds for scenarios that require smoother trajectories and tighter timing.

features.title: Reduces dependence on external IPC hardware
features.desc: The integrated control architecture helps reduce dependence on external IPC hardware and lowers integration complexity.

rail.title: Rail Platform
rail.desc: A rail platform that extends a robot's linear working range, suitable for cross-station linkage and long-travel transfer tasks.

features.title: 1750mm travel
features.desc: Suitable for extending the robot's working range along a straight path.

features.title: Balances speed and positioning
features.desc: A maximum speed of 500mm/s and positioning accuracy of 0.21mm/300mm fit linked transfer workflows.

features.title: Modular integration
features.desc: Gigabit Ethernet and USB interfaces make it easier to use as an add-on module in an existing system.

rotating-platform.title: Rotating Platform
rotating-platform.desc: A rotating platform that adds station indexing and posture adjustment, suitable for multi-angle pick-and-place and direction-change tasks.

features.title: Supports ±360° indexing
features.desc: Suitable for angle changes, transfer alignment, and station direction adjustment.

features.title: Stable rotation accuracy
features.desc: Positioning accuracy of ≤1 arcmin and repeatability of ≤10 arcsec fit posture-adjustment tasks.

features.title: Suitable as an add-on module
features.desc: Useful after the main robot body is chosen, helping extend station adaptability.

za-r3m-left.title: ZA-R3M(L) Rail Platform-Integrated
za-r3m-left.desc: A ZA-R3M plus rail-platform configuration for cross-station linear pick-and-place, continuous transfer, and long-travel coverage.

features.title: Rail extends linear coverage
features.desc: Adds a rail platform to ZA-R3M to expand the operating range along a straight path.

features.title: Fits cross-station linkage
features.desc: Suitable for cross-station pick-and-place, transfer and continuous linear workflows.

features.title: Selection by travel and takt
features.desc: A practical option when the robot body is suitable but straight-line range is insufficient, and rail travel plus takt time become the priority.

params.value: Cross-station linear pick-and-place and linked transfer
Rail Platform travel, takt time, and overall footprint

za-r3m-right.title: ZA-R3M(R) Rotary-Platform Integrated
za-r3m-right.desc: A ZA-R3M plus rotating-platform configuration for multi-angle transfer, posture adjustment, and station direction changes.

features.title: Rotating platform adds indexing capability
features.desc: Adds a rotating platform to ZA-R3M for pick-and-place tasks that need angle switching.

features.title: Fits rotation-based stations
features.desc: Suitable for multi-angle transfer, posture switching and station-direction adjustment.

features.title: Selection by precision and layout
features.desc: Useful when rotation precision, takt requirements, and station layout drive the combination choice.

params.value: Rotation precision, takt time, and station layout
